usedFor: PayHere holds payments, and HubSpot receives a note on the contact when “Payment Received” runs “Add Notes to Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Payment Received” in PayHere, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each payment is logged on the customer's HubSpot contact, so sales sees it without asking finance.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email, so the payer's email must match a HubSpot contact.
